payload.author: claude
payload.body: Fixed + merged to main (PR #11, 37cc2b8). mint_email_session_response now returns the wrapped { session, user, isNewUser } envelope; unit test email_signup_returns_wrapped_session_envelope pins the shape. Scope: email responder only (generic/dev/login/refresh correctly return bare FrickSession; Apple/Google not mounted). Verified end-to-end against RangerCRM Swift suite (353/0). Follow-up: add HTTP-auth-envelope conformance fixtures (gap that let this ship).
